mentions.name: The Drug App
mentions.description: A CAD for drug design focused on structural analysis, letting biologists, crystallographers and chemists quickly analyze large samples of structural data to find patterns and where patterns break down. The goal is a platform to analyze outputs of papers, tools and structures (e.g., AlphaFold, Diffdock) into a single unified biological model of a druggable target, surfacing disagreements between simplified scientific lenses early, before money is spent on lab experiments.
mentions.problem: Biology is extremely complicated, so scientists create simplified lenses of the world to make sense of things. Finding disagreements in these simplified lenses early can save a lot of money before things move to lab experiments.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The Drug App - a CAD for drug design.

It's focused on structural analysis right now, but the goal is to allow for biologists, crystallographers, chemists, etc to quickly analyze large samples of structural data for patterns and find where those patterns break down.
